title: Business-Wrap organisation profile
description: Everything about the organisation that a document names and the code must never hard-code. Samples: samples/organisation/*.profile.json (fictional). A real profile lives with the user's documents (or .local/), never in this repository.

entity.description: the organisation's name as a sentence reads it

terms.description: overrides of the pack glossary: customer, request, customerChannel, staffChannel …

codes.description: the document-code table, keyed by the process key or name. The code is looked up here (or in the record), never derived; a missing code stops the build

docCodes.description: the document id's own code (a mnemonic, e.g. a three-letter token), keyed like codes. A service missing here uses its service code in the id, and the healer record-present WARNs naming it

codeFormat.description: e.g. ORG-SRS-{code}-01 ({code} = the docCodes entry, else the service code)

fileName.description: the export's file name per edition, e.g. «{name} - Requirements» ({name} = the title's service name, {code} = the document id, {locale}); spaces kept. Absent: <service key>.<locale>

footer.description: the footer mark per edition (classification · producer), e.g. «Confidential · EXAMPLE CO»; absent: the design pack's label

attachments.description: the organisation's one upload picker (formats, size limit): printed in §2.6 for a document whose evidence names none; without it the cell is «—», never «unknown»

columns.description: a table's column words in the organisation's own template ({<columns key>: {ar: [...], en: [...]}}); the count must equal the pack's, else the pack's words stay

integrationRules.description: integration rows the form implies, applied only when the record states nothing for that list (source crawl+rule)

when.description: regular expressions on a step title (panel), a field key (control), a field label (label): a field matching all given → one row

perOption.description: {control}: one row per option of the field whose key matches; {option} in the row text is that option

cases.description: [{match, <cell>: {ar, en}}]: per-option cell overrides, first match on the folded option wins

control.description: control-table values ({ar,en}): preparedBy (a person or team), owner, classification, status, reviewCycle, documentType

maxRows.description: the revisions table keeps the last N rows, this issue included

questionsInDocument.description: print the open questions inside the document (default false: the document carries no questions list and no question id; they go to open-questions.md beside it — healers no-oq-chapter, no-questions-in-pdf)

backOffice.description: the organisation has a back office whose request-type page states code, fees, directorate, place and validity: those sections may not stay open questions (healer record-present)

codePattern.description: a regular expression every service code must match (e.g. digits only)

readinessDefault.description: readiness printed where a record row states none

rules.description: overrides of the pack's rules settings: maxCount, struckFamilies, backOfficeOnly, derived, sequential (print BR-01…n gap-free; the fixed codes stay in the table's $codes for the stability check), routing (false: no rule for a gateway on a computed value)

reflectWaive.description: areas (requirements, stories, fields, stages, assumptions) where saying less than the earlier document is an accepted correction

pageFill.description: page-fill thresholds on the exported PDF (default 0.8 / 0.4)

fontsAllow.description: font names the export may embed besides the chosen faces

captions.description: action captions by action key, when the system's own buttons are known

customerActors.description: model actor names that are the customer side

threshold.description: an option list this long prints its count only (default 30)

text.description: per-language overrides of any core or pack wording

logos.description: logo files for the theme (see bible/06)
